title: Cross-system beauty composition and visual QA
start_policy: Start now using published candidates, frozen inputs, or explicit local proxies; integration_inputs are convergence obligations, not start gates.
scope: Own reference metadata, contact sheets, visual-defect routing, combined fixtures, convergence review, and candidate v2 handoff assembly without editing visual implementations.

First publish a small runnable gameplay-context recipe and preview, then a sparse/frontier variant, following GAMEPLAY_BENCHMARKS.md; use explicitly provisional terrain if needed without waiting for other owners.
Audit all tracks' named test.biq regions and source/augmentation provenance against REAL_MAP_VALIDATION.md; Q0 supplies the initial verified registry for final real-map acceptance, not track startup.
acceptance: No release-blocking seam, stretch, repetitive shoreline, route break, raised diamond, floating body, inconsistent shadow, depth inversion, scale anomaly, or facing violation remains in the combined two-zoom/four-phase matrix.
Combined clarity passes actual-size still and motion review, with unsharpened/isolation controls, measured performance and memory, no halo or temporal artifacts, and bounded D3D11 parity.

Q7's city-specific acceptance report passes isolated and composed review for building separation, cohesive layout, facing, scale, shared shadows, localized night lights, and neighbor/label clearance across its coverage ledger.

A civ3.real_gameplay_layout-guided developed scenario plus sparse and crowded variants use verified real terrain and separate deterministic Lab placements, with declared scenario constraints, plausible city/route/improvement/unit distribution, retained-label/HUD clearance witnesses, and readability across both zooms, four phases, and scrolling.

real_map_review.acceptance: Every visual track has relevant named real-map and neighboring/held-out evidence, source/coordinate/layer provenance, and unchanged base-terrain controls. Campaign contact sheets cover distinct map locations and explicitly document gaps requiring synthetic fixtures.

shoreline_review.acceptance: Hill-to-water edges remain rocky with coherent hilltop/rock/water contact and mixed rocky/sandy joins at both zooms; no sand ribbon below cliffs or wave/foam dependency.
